REPOSITORY VERIFIED.

Continue with engineering execution.

1. Inspect all files under:
   .github/workflows/

2. Repair every invalid workflow YAML.

3. Validate every workflow until GitHub reports VALID.

4. Commit all workflow fixes.

5. Push to GitHub.

6. Re-run every failed GitHub Action.

7. Return:

- Commit SHA
- Branch
- GitHub Actions run IDs
- Workflow validation PASS
- Remaining failures

If workflow validation passes, continue automatically with:

- Fix remaining CI failures.
- Build Android APK.
- Build Android AAB.
- Verify Render deployment.
- Verify /health and /version.
- Run real-device QA.
- Return complete production evidence.

Do not stop after cloning.
Do not stop after diagnostics.
Continue until every executable step is complete or a verified external blocker is encountered.
